Offline map packages can currently be requested for **Europe only**.

## Before requesting

- [ ] The requested area is in Europe.
- [ ] I checked the [offline map catalogue](https://opentopomap.nitri.org/offline/) and could not find a suitable package.
- [ ] I searched existing issues for a request covering the same area.

## Country and region

Name the country and the region you would like covered (for example, a German state, a French region, a national park or a hiking area).

## Coverage boundaries

Describe the area clearly. Include a map link, a screenshot with the boundary marked, or a bounding box if available.

For a bounding box, use decimal degrees in this order: **west, south, east, north** (longitude, latitude, longitude, latitude).

## Intended use and detail (optional)

For example: hiking, cycling or a regional overview. If you need particular zoom levels, mention them here.

## Additional information (optional)

Add any other details that help define the package.
